title: A Two-Inch Crab Is the Fastest Crustacean on Land

scenes.text: This two-inch crab is the fastest crustacean on land. Guess how fast.
It's the ghost crab, and Guinness World Records lists it at about four meters a second.
That's roughly nine miles an hour, faster than most people jog.
By day it hides in a burrow dug up to four feet deep in the sand.
Older crabs dig as far as thirteen hundred feet from the sea.
Two inches wide, and faster than a jogger.

description:

first_comment: Would you race a ghost crab on the beach? Guess its speed before you answer.
